questions.q: What is Azure Event Hubs built for?
options: Ingesting massive volumes of events — millions per second — from many producers at once
Storing files that are later batch-processed
Only for IoT device management, nothing else
Running scheduled notebook jobs
questions.explain: This is genuinely different infrastructure from Autoloader, which watched files already sitting in storage.

questions.q: What does IoT Hub add on top of what Event Hubs alone provides?
options: Device identity management, bi-directional communication, and device-specific security
Nothing; they are functionally identical
A completely different event format incompatible with Eventstreams
Only a lower price point, with no functional difference
questions.explain: Bi-directional communication means sending commands back to a device, not just receiving events from it.

questions.q: Why is IoT Hub the wrong choice for this course's simulated taxi trip events?
options: There are no real physical devices with commands to send back to — Event Hubs is the simpler, sufficient choice
IoT Hub cannot be used as an Eventstream source at all
IoT Hub only works with batch data, never streaming events
Event Hubs cannot handle NYC Taxi data specifically
questions.explain: IoT Hub's extra device-management features aren't needed for a simulated event stream.

questions.q: How does this course simulate a real-time NYC Taxi event stream?
options: A script (or Fabric's sample-data source) publishes one event per simulated trip to an Event Hub, standing in for a real dispatch system
The static CSV files from earlier chapters are used directly with no streaming involved
It requires a real physical taxi fleet to generate events
Simulated streams are not possible in Fabric at all
questions.explain: The rest of this chapter builds against this exact simulated stream.

questions.q: How do you connect Azure Event Hubs as an Eventstream source?
options: In the Eventstream canvas, select Add source, choose Azure Event Hubs, and provide a connection string
Event Hubs cannot be used as an Eventstream source; only files can
It requires writing a custom PySpark notebook first
It requires creating a Warehouse item before adding the source
questions.explain: This directly reuses the Eventstream canvas mechanics from Lesson 19.
